## Review checklist

- [ ] A regression test fails without the fix and passes with it.
- [ ] `npm run check` passes.
- [ ] The relevant unit, simulation, and browser checks pass; omitted checks are explained.
- [ ] User-visible behavior has a `CHANGELOG.md` entry and the intended release impact is stated.
- [ ] Public docs, declarations, protocol schema, and test vectors move with the contract.
- [ ] Generated or blessed artifacts were regenerated by their documented command and reviewed as diffs.
- [ ] Dependency changes include the appropriate root or fixture lockfile.
- [ ] Hot-path changes include before/after benchmark numbers and the exact harness.
- [ ] Security-sensitive details were reported through `SECURITY.md`, not disclosed here.
- [ ] No secrets, tokens, cookies, personal data, or private deployment details appear in the diff or logs.

## Risk and rollback

Name the failure mode this could introduce, the compatibility boundary, and the
smallest safe rollback.
